partition_params_by_predicate: partition Haiku parameters into two groups using a boolean predicate on module name and parameter name
partition_n_params_by_bucket: partition Haiku parameters into n buckets using a function that returns an integer index for each parameter
filter_params_by_predicate: filter Haiku parameters to keep only those matching a boolean predicate on module name and parameter name
map_fn_over_params: map a transformation function over all Haiku parameters returning a new structure with transformed values
merge_param_structures: merge multiple Haiku parameter structures into one with optional duplicate shape and dtype checking
